reference: If he had added a whole spoon, the dish would have been too hot to eat.
sk: Keby pridal celú lyžicu, jedlo by bolo príliš pálivé na jedenie.
cz: Kdyby přidal celou lžíci, jídlo by bylo příliš pálivé na jedení.
acceptable: If he had added a {whole spoon|whole spoonful|full spoon|full spoonful}, the {dish|food|meal} would have been too {hot|spicy} to eat.
The {dish|food|meal} would have been too {hot|spicy} to eat if he had added a {whole spoon|whole spoonful|full spoon|full spoonful}.
Had he added a {whole spoon|whole spoonful}, the {dish|food|meal} would have been too {hot|spicy} to eat.

mistakes.text: If he would have added a whole spoon, the dish would have been too {hot|spicy} to eat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; v Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „if he had added“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; ve Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „if he had added“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; the Third Conditional uses the Past Perfect there: “if he had added”.

mistakes.text: If he added a whole spoon, the dish would be too {hot|spicy} to eat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o minulosť, ktorá sa nestala, preto Third Conditional: „had added … would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o minulost, která se nestala, proto Third Conditional: „had added … would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is about an unreal past, so use the Third Conditional: “had added … would have been”.

mistakes.text: If he had added a whole spoon, the dish would be too {hot|spicy} to eat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Následok je tiež v minulosti, preto v Third Conditional: „would have been too hot“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Následek je také v minulosti, proto ve Third Conditional: „would have been too hot“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The result is also in the past, so the Third Conditional “would have been too hot” fits better.

mistakes.text: If he had added a whole spoon, the dish would have been too {hot|spicy} for eating.
mistakes.kind: for eating instead of to eat
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „too + prídavné meno“ je prirodzenejší Infinitive: „too hot to eat“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „too + přídavné jméno“ je přirozenější Infinitive: „too hot to eat“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “too + adjective” the Infinitive is more natural: “too hot to eat”.

mistakes.text: If he had add a whole spoon, the dish would have been too {hot|spicy} to eat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „had“ patrí tretí tvar slovesa: „had added“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „had“ patří třetí tvar slovesa: „had added“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “had” use the past participle: “had added”.

mistakes.text: If he had added a whole spoon, the dish would had been too {hot|spicy} to eat.
mistakes.kind: would had instead of would have
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ patrí vždy „have“, nie „had“: „would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ patří vždy „have“, ne „had“: „would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “would” always use “have”, not “had”: “would have been”.
